articles.title: Returns and refunds policy
articles.body: Customers may return any item within 30 days of delivery for a full refund. Items must be unused and in original packaging. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days of the return being received. Sale items are refundable as store credit only.

articles.title: Shipping times and carriers
articles.body: Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days within Australia and 7-14 business days internationally. Express shipping (1-2 business days domestic) is available at checkout. Orders placed before 12pm AEST ship the same day. All parcels are tracked.

articles.title: Warranty claims process
articles.body: All products carry a 12-month manufacturer warranty. To lodge a claim, customers email support with their order number and photos of the fault. Approved claims receive a replacement or repair; freight for approved claims is covered by us.

articles.title: Price matching policy
articles.body: We match advertised prices from authorised Australian retailers on identical, in-stock items. Requests must include a link to the competitor listing. Price matching cannot be combined with other discounts and excludes clearance stock.

glossary.RMA: Return Merchandise Authorisation — the reference number issued for an approved return.
glossary.DOA: Dead on arrival — a product faulty at first use, eligible for immediate replacement.
glossary.3PL: Third-party logistics provider that operates our warehouse and shipping.
